executive_summary: The project aims to replace outdated, spreadsheet‑driven recruitment processes with a cloud‑native SaaS recruitment platform built on Microsoft Azure. The solution will provide end‑to‑end job and candidate management, AI‑powered resume parsing, searchable candidate data, automated interview scheduling, and comprehensive dashboards for recruiters, hiring managers, and executives. Key decisions include using Azure AD Entra ID for SSO, .NET 8 APIs on Azure App Service, React SPA via Azure Static Web Apps, and Azure AI services for parsing and search. The recommendation is to proceed with a phased MVP that delivers core recruiting functionality within the six‑month timeline while deferring advanced analytics and optional services to later phases.
background_summary: The client currently manages recruitment across 35 countries with 28,000 employees using a mix of Workday, Excel, and SharePoint, resulting in fragmented data, duplicate effort, and prolonged time‑to‑hire. Manual processes such as resume review, interview scheduling, and status communication are causing high costs, candidate dissatisfaction, and low recruiter trust in existing systems.

recommendations_next_steps: Begin with a sprint‑0 kickoff to finalize scope, confirm Azure subscriptions, and establish the core DevOps foundation (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, and Entra ID configuration). Form a cross‑functional delivery team comprising a product owner, Azure‑experienced architects, .NET backend developers, React front‑end engineers, and a QA lead. Deliver the MVP in three incremental releases: (1) Core job and candidate data model with Azure SQL and basic CRUD APIs; (2) Recruiter portal UI, resume upload, and asynchronous parsing pipeline; (3) Interview scheduling integration with Outlook/Teams and basic dashboards. Target key milestones at the end of months 2, 4, and 6, with a go‑live gate after the third release. Capture user feedback early to prioritize deferred features such as advanced AI Search and Power BI analytics for the post‑MVP roadmap.
architecture_summary: The Azure‑first, cloud‑native architecture was chosen to leverage the client’s existing Microsoft investment, meet global availability requirements, and provide a secure, compliant foundation. Azure AD Entra ID delivers unified SSO and granular RBAC, while Azure SQL Managed Instance ensures relational consistency for core HR data. AI services (Document Intelligence and AI Search) deliver the required resume parsing and semantic search capabilities, and Logic Apps orchestrate integrations with Workday, Teams, and Outlook. This combination satisfies functional and non‑functional goals—performance, scalability, security, and maintainability—while aligning with budget and timeline constraints through modular, IaC‑driven deployment.

recommendation_reason.cloud_platform: Leverages Azure globally distributed edge services (Front Door, Traffic Manager) to meet 99.9% availability and multi‑region latency goals while staying within the mandated Azure ecosystem.
recommendation_reason.authentication_authorization: Uses existing Microsoft Entra ID licenses for SSO, adds Azure AD B2C for external candidate sign‑in, and enforces MFA and RBAC required by GDPR and corporate policy.
recommendation_reason.frontend: React provides a fast, responsive UI; Azure Static Web Apps offers zero‑maintenance hosting and integrates directly with Azure AD for SSO, keeping costs low for the MVP.
recommendation_reason.backend_api: .NET 8 on Azure App Service is a mature, Microsoft‑first stack that integrates natively with Azure services, reduces dev learning curve, and supports high throughput needed for sub‑5‑second dashboard loads.
recommendation_reason.database: Azure SQL Managed Instance gives relational consistency for job, candidate, and audit tables, offers built‑in encryption at rest/transit, and scales to the projected 250k annual applications.
recommendation_reason.search: Azure AI Search provides sub‑2‑second indexed queries, semantic ranking, and built‑in security filtering, eliminating the need for custom search infrastructure.
recommendation_reason.storage: Blob Storage offers durable, encrypted object storage for resumes, with direct integration to Document Intelligence for parsing pipelines.
recommendation_reason.resume_parsing: Document Intelligence (Form Recognizer) parses PDFs/Word resumes within the 10‑second SLA; Azure AI Language adds entity extraction and similarity scoring for candidate matching.
recommendation_reason.integration: Logic Apps enable low‑code, auditable connectors to Workday (REST/SOAP), Outlook Calendar, Teams, and SharePoint, respecting the 6‑month MVP timeline and reducing custom code.
recommendation_reason.messaging_queue: Service Bus decouples long‑running tasks (parsing, notifications) for reliability and allows horizontal scaling without impacting API latency.
recommendation_reason.notification_service: Notification Hubs + SendGrid deliver multi‑channel alerts (email, Teams) within seconds, improving candidate experience and recruiter responsiveness.
recommendation_reason.caching: Redis cache reduces repeated look‑ups (e.g., permission checks, recent searches) to keep API response times under 2 seconds.
recommendation_reason.monitoring_observability: Azure Monitor suite provides end‑to‑end telemetry, alerting on SLA breaches, and stores immutable audit logs for GDPR compliance.
recommendation_reason.ci_cd: Azure DevOps Pipelines with IaC ensures repeatable, compliant deployments across dev/test/prod environments within the compressed schedule.
recommendation_reason.governance_security: Key Vault secures all secrets; Azure Policy enforces encryption, location, and retention rules; Sentinel can be added later for advanced threat detection.
recommendation_reason.analytics_reporting: Power BI Embedded re‑uses existing Microsoft licensing, offers rich interactive dashboards for recruiters, hiring managers, and executives without building a custom visualization layer.

architecture_summary.overview: A Azure‑centric, modular recruitment platform that centralizes job and candidate data, provides AI‑assisted resume parsing, fast semantic search, automated interview scheduling, and role‑based dashboards while reusing the organization’s Microsoft identity, collaboration, and reporting investments.
architecture_summary.workflow: Recruiters and hiring managers sign in via Entra ID, create/manage job requisitions in the Recruiter Portal, and upload or view candidate resumes. Candidates log in via Azure AD B2C to a self‑service portal where they submit applications, view status, and schedule interviews. Uploaded resumes are stored in Blob Storage, queued to Service Bus, processed by Document Intelligence, and indexed in Azure AI Search. The scheduling service uses Logic Apps to create Outlook Calendar events and Teams meeting links. Dashboards pull aggregated metrics from Azure SQL and present them via Power BI Embedded.
architecture_summary.data_flow: User action → API Gateway (App Service) → Auth (Entra ID/B2C) → Business logic (App Service) → (a) Azure SQL for transactional writes, (b) Blob Storage for resume files, (c) Service Bus for async jobs → Document Intelligence parses file → results stored in Azure SQL & indexed in Azure AI Search → Search queries hit Azure AI Search → results returned to frontend. All changes emit audit events to Log Analytics for compliance.

feasibility.feasibility_summary: The proposed architecture aligns well with the Azure‑first mandate and covers all mandatory integrations, security, and compliance requirements. It leverages Azure native services to provide search, AI parsing, and workflow automation, which satisfies performance and availability targets on paper. However, the breadth of components (Front Door, Traffic Manager, AI Search, Form Recognizer, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Redis, Power BI Embedded, etc.) introduces significant implementation complexity for a six‑month MVP. The plan may exceed the realistic capacity of a typical recruitment‑technology team unless the scope is trimmed or the team is very experienced with Azure. Overall, the design is technically sound but aggressive in scope and schedule.

technical_risks.risk: Workday integration via Logic Apps may require custom connectors or complex authentication handling, risking delays and data inconsistency.
technical_risks.impact: Integration failures could block core job and candidate data sync, jeopardizing the MVP timeline and causing inaccurate recruiter dashboards.
technical_risks.mitigation: Develop a dedicated Workday integration service using the official Workday API SDK, validate authentication flows early, and include comprehensive contract tests before integrating with Logic Apps.

technical_risks.risk: AI‑based resume parsing and Azure AI Search may experience variable latency or throttling under peak loads, breaching the 10‑second parsing and 2‑second search SLAs.
technical_risks.impact: Slow parsing or search responses will degrade recruiter productivity and candidate experience, potentially violating performance commitments.
technical_risks.mitigation: Implement asynchronous processing with Service Bus, set concurrency limits, pre‑warm Form Recognizer models, and monitor service quotas; add a fallback simple OCR parser for oversized documents.

technical_risks.risk: The extensive set of Azure services (Front Door, Traffic Manager, Redis, Power BI Embedded, etc.) adds operational and DevOps complexity that may exceed the team's skill set within six months.
technical_risks.impact: Complex deployment pipelines and environment management could cause schedule slippage, configuration drift, and higher operational costs.
technical_risks.mitigation: Adopt a phased MVP approach: start with core API, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, and basic search; defer advanced services (AI Search, Form Recognizer, Power BI Embedded) to later releases, and use Azure DevOps templates to standardize IaC.

technical_risks.risk: Storing candidate resumes globally may conflict with GDPR data‑residency requirements across 35 countries.
technical_risks.impact: Non‑compliance could result in legal penalties and loss of trust among European users.
technical_risks.mitigation: Enforce Azure Policy to restrict Blob Storage to approved EU regions, enable geo‑redundant replication within compliant zones, and maintain an audit trail of data location for each document.
